newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-TELECOM ATTRACTS BRITISH, FRENCH FIRMS.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-TELECOM ATTRACTS BRITISH, FRENCH FIRMS.

text.p: Lithuanian European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene said on Thursday that 12 companies, including British Telecom, France Telecom, and TeleDenmark had expressed interest in privatising Lithuanian Telecom.
In an interview with Reuters, she said the Lithuanian government would hold on to no more than 34 percent of the telecoms company and telecom employees no more than five percent.
"This week we will start discussions and Telecom is one of the first on that list so we have to finish that job in parliament by the end of this month," she told Reuters.

"Those that have already expressed an interest are Nomura International, Merrill Lynch, British Telecom , French Telecom, Canadian Telecom, TeleDanmark, Norwegian telecom, Banque Paribas," Andrikiene said. "I have a list of 12."
She said that an international tender to select an advisor for the privatisation of Lithuanian Telecom would be made at the end of this month.
